bounds: One recording, one canonical note, originating versus foreign owner, and at most one canonical-create claim. IndexedDB writes are atomic transitions.
fairness: Safety holds without fairness. No automatic retry or successful canonical create is promised; recovery requires an owner action and an authoritative note match.
limitations: Blob byte equality is abstracted; concrete byte, identity and crash-recovery behavior is checked by the storage tests. Browser capture before Stop, browser storage eviction, cross-origin transport and canonical Notes server admission are outside this store model.
